title: Fragma & Maria Rubia - Let Me Breathe (2026)

lines.l: Love found me, from my knees, to the sky
A love has found me, let me breathe
Let me fly, I know there's no return
I'm back on track and there's no turning back
No wrong direction, is this what I was longing for?
Your eyes saw me and I began to see my own reflection
Behind your eyes there's so much more
Let me breathe, let me fly
I'll break those chains that found me
From my knees to the sky
A love has found me, found me
Let me breathe, let me fly
